item.tib: shi ri log dbang gi sgron me bdud rtsi'i thig pa
item.coloph: zhes 'di ni shin tu ngo mtshar che/ rig 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi thugs bcud yin/ khye'u dran pa nam mkha'i zhu don yin/ rig 'dzin mkhas pa dgu'i (dgus) gnang ba yin/ lha sku rigs stobs ye shes grol ba dang*/ phung po lha skur myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ phyi ma rig 'dzin sa la 'khod par 'gyur/ de phyir gsang sngags 'di la nan tan mdzod/ sngon gyi rig 'dzin rnams kyi gsung ras snang / dus 'dir gshen po kun gyis rjes 'jug mdzod/ bkra shis bstan pa yongs la khyab/ ma gyur 'gro ba sems can rnams/ kun mkhyen sa la 'khod par shog dbang shi ri log sgron me bdud rtsi thig pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so//
